Chapter 485 - 485 Sea Fishing; It'S Her!

Chapter 485 - 485 Sea Fishing; It's Her!

485 Sea Fishing; It’s Her!

For the next two days, Lin Fan, Chu Yunyue, and the other employees of Flower Stem led similar lives every day.

They would go to the sports island in the morning, have lunch at LEE1947, a three-star Michelin restaurant, have a massage on the spa island in the afternoon, and play on the beach or attend a bonfire party at night…

Although they repeated the same routine, everyone still had blissful smiles on their faces.

However, Grians was worried that Lin Fan would not be satisfied.

Therefore, he spent a lot of effort to get a large yacht from somewhere else.

…

After Lin Fan and Chu Yunyue woke up and ate breakfast, Grians bowed like the most respectful waiter and said, “Mr. Lin, Ms. Chu, good morning.”

Lin Fan was quite satisfied with Grians.

From the initial pick-up to the daily service after arriving at the Whitehorse Manor, to how he dealt with Qin Changcun… he performed very well.

Therefore, Lin Fan nodded in response to Grianth’s greeting, “Good morning, Grians.”

Although it was just a simple greeting, it sounded like heavenly music to Grians’ ears, making him excited.

This meant that Lin Fan was satisfied with him.

Grians suppressed his joy and said, “Mr. Lin, I’ve brought in an MJ yacht from another place. I wonder if you and Ms. Chu want to take it out to sea?”

Lin Fan could not help but look at Grians.

One had to know…

Lin Fan also owned a top-grade yacht, Solange, which was still docked at the port of Modu.

It was because of this that he had specially searched for information about yachts.

Even though an MJ yacht was not as luxurious as Solange, its price exceeded 100 million yuan.

With Grians’ status, it would probably take some effort to bring over such a large yacht.

Grians was really thoughtful!

Lin Fan nodded and asked, “Yunyue and the rest… Do you want to go on a yacht to play at sea?”

In fact, when Grians said that he had brought over a yacht, everyone was shocked.

Yang Changlin, Li Rujing, and all the employees of Flower Stem were tempted.

Now, hearing Lin Fan’s question, their eyes lit up.

This was because taking a yacht to play out on the sea was a scene that only appeared in movies and television dramas.

At the same time, it was something that all of them had been yearning for.

However, no one responded.

Chu Yunyue looked at the crowd, but they did not dare to speak. She could not help but smile and say, “Look at you guys… Let’s go on the yacht, then.”

“That’s great!” everyone shouted excitedly.

After a while, an extremely fashionable and cool 50-meter-long yacht appeared in everyone’s sight.

This… It was an MJ yacht!

Flower Stem’s staff members could not help but open their mouths and exclaim.

“Wow! This is too big!”

“So handsome!”

“So cool!”

However, what they did not know was that Lin Fan’s Solange which was docked at the Modu pier was much bigger than MJ and was twice as big!

…

The tourists who were relaxing on the reclining chairs in the Whitehorse Manor also raised their heads and looked over curiously.

…

Lin Fan said, “Then let’s go up.”

“Alright,” everyone hurriedly responded.

After boarding the yacht, everyone’s jaws dropped again.

A wide deck, a gorgeous restaurant, an exquisite private room, a bar with all kinds of drinks, and a video room…

It was as if they had arrived at a mobile club on the sea.

As MJ’s yacht let out a soft hum, everyone felt a gust of wind blow over.

Then, it continued to move forward toward the endless sea.

Instantly, an unprecedented sense of satisfaction filled everyone’s hearts.

Laughter and shouts rang out endlessly.

MJ cruised at high speed for more than an hour before slowing down.

“There are fishing rods here!” Yang Changlin said excitedly.

Hence, everyone stepped forward and picked one up.

Those who liked fishing were naturally enthusiastic.

Those who did not also became interested.

After all, this was a rare sea fishing.

Chu Yunyue smiled. “We can eat fresh fish for lunch today.”

After a while, Yang Changlin had a fish on the hook.

He suddenly pulled, and it turned out to be a ribbonfish the length of an arm.

Seeing this, everyone shouted excitedly.

“I’ll help roast the fish!”

Then, someone brought over a barbecue rack, cooking oil, and other things. On the deck, they began to grill the fish.

…

When the employees of Flower Stem were fishing on the MJ yacht, there was another large luxury yacht on the sea.

A group of men with extraordinary temperaments and branded clothes were drinking and laughing with a group of beautiful women on the deck.

Huo Qilong was among them.

“Speaking of beauties, I met a beauty at the Whitehorse Manor two days ago. That figure, that face, that skin…” She’s simply gorgeous!

” A fairy! She’s definitely a fairy!”

Obviously, he was talking about Chu Yunyue.

A man in a striped shirt and dyed light red hair said, “Is that so? Is she as divine as you say?”

A man wearing sunglasses asked, “Are you being for real?”

“Of course!” Huo Qilong said seriously.

“Then why didn’t you bring her over?” a man with an ear stud said.

Huo Qilong poured the XO into his mouth and said, “She has a boyfriend.”

Even though they were all accompanied by beautiful women, they were still talking about other women.

The beauties beside them did not seem to care.

This was the charm of the Maldives.

“She has a boyfriend?” The man in sunglasses laughed. “It’s because I wasn’t the one who met her. Otherwise, I would’ve easily won her over!”

“Of course, I can win her over,” Huo Qilong retorted. “Aren’t we here to gather and have fun? I don’t have enough time.”

The man with an ear stud also took a sip of his drink and said, “I’m already a little interested in this beauty.”

“Hahaha, I’m interested too! I’ll go to the Whitehorse Manor tomorrow and see if I can meet her,” the man in sunglasses said.

“Not bad, I’ll go take a look too,” the man with an ear stud said.

…

“I caught a fish too!”

Not far away, there was a sudden shout.

Huo Qilong, the man wearing sunglasses, the man with an ear stud, and the others all looked in the direction of the voice.

Only then did they realize that a large yacht had appeared not far away.

This was the MJ yacht that Lin Fan and the others were on.

In the next moment…

Huo Qilong stood up abruptly, his eyes fixed on the woman in the white dress. He shouted, “It’s her!”

She was Chu Yunyue!
